title: Shontel Brown criticizes ICE actions and calls for Kristi Noem's resignation
text:

Congresswoman Shontel M. Brown | Shontel M. Brown Official Website
U.S. Representative Shontel Brown, who represents Ohio’s 11th district, issued a series of statements on social media on January 7, 2026, criticizing recent actions involving Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) and calling for the resignation of Secretary Kristi Noem.
In a post published at 21:02 UTC, Brown addressed recent events in Minneapolis, stating: "The news out of Minneapolis is sickening. There must be a full investigation to ensure there is accountability and justice. This is another example of how Trump’s weaponization of unchecked, unaccountable and masked ICE agents is making communities less safe—not more."
Later that evening, at 21:21 UTC, she criticized the legislative decisions under former President Trump regarding ICE funding and their impact on social programs: "This bears repeating today: Trump's Big Ugly Bill tripled ICE's budget and paid for it by kicking millions of Americans off of Medicaid and by taking food aid away from families. More terror. More raids. More chaos. Less health care. Less food. That's the choice they made."
At 22:32 UTC, Brown called for the immediate resignation of Secretary Kristi Noem due to her leadership over ICE: "Kristi Noem must resign today. Her time as Secretary has been a complete moral failure and a public safety disaster. ICE under her leadership has repeatedly ignored our laws, terrorized communities, and made America less safe. She must resign."
Brown has represented Ohio’s 11th District in Congress since 2021 after succeeding Marcia Fudge; prior to her tenure in Congress, she served on the Cuyahoga County Council from 2015 to 2021. Born in Cleveland in 1975 and currently residing in Warrensville Heights, Brown holds a Bachelor of Science degree from Wilberforce University.
